+"""
+Loads image bytes from an image reference a user may have set
+(cut.image_path, character / style reference URLs, ...).
+
+Only two kinds of reference are honoured:
+
+* ``data:`` URLs (base64), decoded in memory;
+* images in our own storage, given either as a relative object path
+  (``schema/id/file.png``) or as a full URL under ``settings.STORAGE_HOST``.
+  These are read through the storage client, never over HTTP.
+
+Anything else (arbitrary http(s) URLs, other schemes) is refused, so the
+backend never requests an address a user chose.
+"""
+import base64
+import binascii
+from typing import Optional
+from urllib.parse import unquote, urlsplit
+
+from app.core.config import settings
+
+
+def _storage_relative_path(ref: str) -> Optional[str]:
+    """Returns the storage object path for ``ref``, or None if ``ref`` does
+    not point into our storage."""
+    if "://" in ref or ref.startswith("//"):
+        host = settings.STORAGE_HOST
+        if not host:
+            return None
+        try:
+            got = urlsplit(ref)
+            base = urlsplit(host)
+        except ValueError:
+            return None
+        if got.scheme.lower() != base.scheme.lower() or got.netloc.lower() != base.netloc.lower():
+            return None
+        prefix = base.path.rstrip("/") + "/"
+        if not got.path.startswith(prefix):
+            return None
+        path = unquote(got.path[len(prefix):])
+    else:
+        if ":" in ref.split("/", 1)[0]:
+            # Some other scheme (file:, gopher:, ...).
+            return None
+        path = ref
+
+    path = path.lstrip("/")
+    segments = path.split("/")
+    if not path or any(s in ("", ".", "..") for s in segments) or "\\" in path:
+        return None
+    return path
+
+
+def _decode_data_url(ref: str) -> Optional[bytes]:
+    try:
+        header, encoded = ref.split(",", 1)
+    except ValueError:
+        return None
+    if ";base64" not in header.lower():
+        return None
+    try:
+        return base64.b64decode(encoded)
+    except (binascii.Error, ValueError):
+        return None
+
+
+def load_image_bytes(ref: Optional[str]) -> Optional[bytes]:
+    """Returns the bytes of the image ``ref`` points to, or None if it cannot
+    be loaded or points outside our storage."""
+    if not ref or not isinstance(ref, str):
+        return None
+    ref = ref.strip()
+    if ref[:5].lower() == "data:":
+        return _decode_data_url(ref)
+
+    path = _storage_relative_path(ref)
+    if path is None:
+        print(f"[ImageSource] Refused image outside storage: {ref[:100]}")
+        return None
+
+    from app.services.storage import storage
+    try:
+        return storage.download_image(path)
+    except Exception as e:
+        print(f"[ImageSource] Storage download failed: {e}")
+        return None

+"""Exports report the cuts they leave out: missing.txt in the ZIP and the
+X-Missing-Cuts header on both formats."""
+import base64
+import io
+import zipfile
+
+from tests.conftest import signup
+from tests.lab_env import PNG, FakeMinio
+
+DATA_URL = "data:image/png;base64," + base64.b64encode(PNG).decode()
+
+
+def _episode_with_cuts(client, h, image_paths):
+    """Creates an episode with one cut per entry (cut numbers 1, 2, ...);
+    None leaves the cut without an image."""
+    project = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=h, json={"title": "Night Bus", "genres": []}).json()
+    episode = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes", headers=h, json={"title": "Ep 1", "project_id": project["id"], "episode_order": 1}
+    ).json()
+    for order, path in enumerate(image_paths, start=1):
+        r = client.post(
+            "/api/v1/cuts", headers=h, json={"episode_id": episode["id"], "cut_order": order, "image_path": path}
+        )
+        assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return episode["id"]
+
+
+def _export(client, h, episode_id, fmt):
+    return client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format={fmt}", headers=h)
+
+
+def test_zip_lists_missing_cuts_in_file_and_header(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    episode_id = _episode_with_cuts(
+        client,
+        h,
+        [
+            DATA_URL,
+            None,  # no image yet
+            "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/",  # refused address
+            "cuts/gone/never-uploaded.png",  # cannot be loaded
+            DATA_URL,
+        ],
+    )
+
+    r = _export(client, h, episode_id, "zip")
+
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert r.headers["X-Missing-Cuts"] == "2,3,4"
+    zf = zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(r.content))
+    assert zf.read("missing.txt").decode().splitlines() == ["2", "3", "4"]
+    assert sorted(n for n in zf.namelist() if n.endswith(".png")) == ["Ep_1_01.png", "Ep_1_05.png"]
+
+

+    from app.core.config import settings
+
+    FakeMinio.objects.setdefault(settings.MINIO_BUCKET, {})["cuts/x/a.png"] = PNG

+def no_network(monkeypatch):
+    """Records (and blocks) every outgoing request attempt."""
+    attempts = []
+
+    def refuse(*args, **kwargs):
+        attempts.append(args)
+        raise AssertionError(f"backend tried to reach the network: {args!r}")
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(requests.Session, "request", refuse)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(socket, "create_connection", refuse)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(socket, "getaddrinfo", refuse)
+    return attempts
+

+++ b/frontend/src/lib/exportMissingCuts.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,12 @@
+/**
+ * Reads the cut numbers an episode export left out from its
+ * `X-Missing-Cuts` response header ("2,3,4"). Returns [] when absent.
+ */
+export function getMissingCuts(headers: Record<string, unknown> | undefined | null): number[] {
+  const raw = headers?.['x-missing-cuts'];
+  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || !raw.trim()) return [];
+  return raw
+    .split(',')
+    .map((part) => Number(part.trim()))
+    .filter((n) => Number.isInteger(n));
+}
